meta.about: Picture-first cards for the treatment topics (src/study.js, sTreatmentCard). A topic listed here opens as a card; the full guideline text from treatments.json stays underneath, folded. Every fact comes from treatments.json (BC Provincial Examination Guidelines, June 15, 2026). Quiz patients are adults. A "|" in a headline marks where it may break.
meta.blocks: ladder | never | ticks | bands | fork | phases. A block or a quiz question with "pcp": true shows on the PCP track only.

wound-care.lineEn: Press on it. Still bleeding? Tourniquet on a limb, packing where a tourniquet cannot go.
wound-care.lineZh: 先压住。压不住：四肢上止血带，上不了止血带的地方填塞。

blocks.titleEn: Six ways to stop a bleed, in this order

steps.subEn: only if it harms nothing else
above the wound · note the time
steps.subZh: 绑在伤口近端 · 记下时间

steps.subEn: no tourniquet possible, or still bleeding
steps.subZh: 上不了止血带，或还是止不住

items.en: Loosen a tourniquet. Once on, it stays on.
Pack the neck, chest or abdomen.
Pull out an embedded object. Stabilize it in place, unless it blocks the airway.
items.zh: 拔出插在身上的异物。原位固定，除非堵住气道。

blocks.badToZh: unstable 不稳定 · 快速转运

blocks.titleEn: Where it goes in the exam

rows.en: Expose, look, stop the major bleed, then bandage it.
rows.zh: 暴露、检查，止住大出血，再包扎。

rows.en: Analgesia if the patient needs it.
Clean and dress small wounds. Check the pulse below the injury. Cold only if that pulse is fine. Big wound or over a joint: immobilize the limb.
rows.zh: 小伤口清洁、敷料、包扎。查远端循环。远端循环没问题才冷敷。伤口大或跨关节：固定肢体。

quiz.qEn: A man has a deep cut in his thigh. You press hard on it and it keeps bleeding. Next?
quiz.qZh: 一名男子大腿被割开，很深。你用力压住，血还在流。下一步？

opts.en: Let go and look at the wound again
Put a cold pack on it

quiz.whyEn: Pressure failed and the wound is on a limb, so a tourniquet goes on above it. Note the time.
quiz.whyZh: 压不住，伤口又在四肢，所以在近端上止血带，并记下时间。

quiz.qEn: A woman is bleeding from the groin, where the leg joins the body. Pressure is not holding and a tourniquet will not fit there. Next?
quiz.qZh: 一名女子腹股沟（腿和躯干交界处）出血。压不住，这个位置也上不了止血带。下一步？

opts.en: Tourniquet lower down on the thigh
opts.zh: 把止血带绑在大腿下段

quiz.whyEn: This is a junctional bleed: a tourniquet cannot go there, so the wound is packed. The neck, chest and abdomen are never packed.
quiz.whyZh: 这是交界处出血（junctional hemorrhage）：上不了止血带，所以填塞。颈、胸、腹永远不填塞。

quiz.qEn: A broken forearm has no pulse at the wrist. You realign it once. Still no pulse. This patient is…
quiz.qZh: 前臂骨折，手腕摸不到脉搏。你复位了一次，还是没有脉搏。这位病人算……

opts.en: Stable: splint it and carry on
opts.zh: stable 稳定：固定好，按部就班

quiz.whyEn: Only one attempt is allowed. Pulse back means stable. Still pulseless means unstable, so Rapid Transport.
quiz.whyZh: 只允许复位一次。脉搏回来算 stable；仍然没有就是 unstable，快速转运。

amputated-parts.lineEn: Rinse it, wrap it, bag it, keep it cool, and send it with the patient.
amputated-parts.lineZh: 冲洗、包好、装袋、保持凉，跟病人一起送走。

steps.subEn: cool sterile water, to clear the dirt
steps.subZh: 用凉的无菌水冲掉脏东西
用生理盐水浸湿的无菌纱布

steps.en: Bag it and keep it cool

items.en: Warm it.
Put it in water.
Put it straight on ice.
Use dry ice.

quiz.qEn: A carpenter has cut off a finger. His hand is still bleeding heavily. What comes first?
quiz.qZh: 一名木工切断了一根手指，手还在大量出血。先做什么？

opts.en: Stop the bleeding from his hand
Look for a bag and ice

quiz.whyEn: The part waits. You turn to it only once the patient's injuries are stabilized.
quiz.whyZh: 断肢先放一放。病人的伤稳住了，才去处理断肢。

quiz.qEn: How does the finger travel?
quiz.qZh: 断指怎么带走？

opts.en: In a cup of sterile water
Wrapped in moist gauze, in a bag, kept cool
opts.zh: 湿纱布包好、装袋、保持凉

quiz.whyEn: Rinse, wrap in saline-moistened gauze, bag, keep cool. Never in water and never straight on ice.
quiz.whyZh: 冲洗、盐水湿纱布包好、装袋、保持凉。不泡水，也不直接碰冰。

quiz.qEn: A bystander hands you the finger lying directly on ice cubes. What do you change?
quiz.qZh: 路人把断指直接放在冰块上递给你。你要改什么？

opts.en: Warm it in your hands first
Wrap it and bag it so it does not touch the ice
opts.zh: 包好、装袋，不让它直接碰到冰

quiz.whyEn: Cool, but never directly on ice, and never warmed.
quiz.whyZh: 要保持凉，但不能直接放在冰上，也不能加温。

musculoskeletal-injuries.lineEn: Hold still the joint above and the joint below. Check the pulse below the injury again and again.
musculoskeletal-injuries.lineZh: 固定伤处上面和下面的关节。远端脉搏查了再查。

items.en: the joint above
the injury
the joint below
Expose and examine.
Control major bleeding.
Stabilize the broken limb, pelvis or hip.
items.zh: 稳住骨折的肢体、骨盆或髋部。

items.en: Check the distal pulse, and keep rechecking for the whole call.
items.zh: 查远端脉搏，整个过程反复查。

items.en: Realign a limb that is grossly deformed or pulseless.
items.zh: 严重变形或摸不到脉搏的肢体：复位。

items.en: Bind the pelvis if appropriate. Apply cold.

rows.en: Analgesia before movement, in stable, appropriate patients.
rows.zh: 稳定、合适的病人：搬动之前先给镇痛。

rows.en: Traction if appropriate. Immobilize the joints above and below. Cold again and elevate, if appropriate.
rows.zh: 需要的话做牵引。固定上下两个关节。需要的话再冷敷、抬高。

items.en: Fix the fracture first and give Entonox after. In a stable patient that order is a 100% deduction (Appendix A).
items.zh: 先处理骨折，后给 Entonox（笑气-氧气混合气）。稳定病人这样做，按 100% 扣分（附录 A）。

quiz.qEn: A stable man has a painful broken forearm. You are about to splint it. What comes first?
quiz.qZh: 一名情况稳定的男子前臂骨折，很痛。你正要上夹板。先做什么？

opts.en: Splint now, pain relief in the ambulance
Raise the arm above his head

quiz.whyEn: In a stable, appropriate patient analgesia comes before movement.
quiz.whyZh: 稳定、合适的病人，镇痛在搬动之前。

quiz.qEn: The break is in the middle of the forearm. Which joints does the splint hold still?
quiz.qZh: 骨折在前臂中段。夹板要固定哪两个关节？
quiz.whyEn: The joint above the injury and the joint below it.
quiz.whyZh: 伤处上面一个关节，下面一个关节。

quiz.qEn: The splint is on. What do you check again?
quiz.qZh: 夹板上好了。再查一次什么？
quiz.whyEn: Distal pulses are rechecked throughout the call, above all after realigning or splinting.
quiz.whyZh: 远端脉搏整个过程都要反复查，复位或上夹板之后尤其要查。

hip-dislocation-fracture.headZh: 髋关节脱位，|一律|快速转运。
hip-dislocation-fracture.lineEn: A hip fracture on its own is Rapid Transport only when the nerves or blood supply of the leg are impaired.
hip-dislocation-fracture.lineZh: 单纯的髋部骨折，只有腿的神经或血运受损时才算快速转运。

items.en: always Rapid Transport
nerve or blood supply impaired: Rapid Transport
items.zh: 神经或血运受损：快速转运

items.en: nerves and blood supply fine: not Rapid Transport for the hip alone
items.zh: 神经血运正常：不因髋部算快速转运

steps.en: Onto a firm, blanketed stretcher or a spinal device
steps.zh: 移到铺了毯子的硬担架或脊柱固定装置上

steps.en: Secure the patient so the hip cannot move
steps.zh: 绑好病人，让这侧髋部完全不动

steps.en: Go. The rest of the secondary survey is done en route
steps.zh: 出发。剩下的 secondary survey 在路上做

steps.subEn: vitals · distal pulses · nerve function in that leg
steps.subZh: 生命体征 · 远端脉搏 · 这条腿的神经功能

items.en: Pain management.
If the hip slips back in by itself, tell the receiving hospital.
items.zh: 髋关节如果自己复位了，通知接收医院。

items.en: Early reduction in hospital is what prevents serious long-term damage. That is why you do not wait on scene.
items.zh: 尽早在医院复位，才能避免严重的长期后遗症。所以不在现场耽搁。

quiz.qEn: A woman has a dislocated hip. Her foot is warm, the pulse is strong and feeling is normal. Transport category?
quiz.qZh: 一名女子髋关节脱位。脚是暖的，脉搏有力，感觉正常。转运类别？

opts.en: Not Rapid Transport: the pulse is fine
opts.zh: 不算快速转运：脉搏没问题

opts.en: Rapid Transport: every hip dislocation is
opts.zh: 快速转运：髋关节脱位一律是
做完 secondary survey 再定

quiz.whyEn: All hip dislocations are in the Rapid Transport Category, with or without nerve or vessel problems.
quiz.whyZh: 所有髋关节脱位都属于快速转运，不管神经血运有没有问题。

quiz.qEn: A man has a hip fracture and nothing else. Foot warm, pulse present, feeling normal. Rapid Transport?
quiz.qZh: 一名男子只有髋部骨折。脚暖、有脉搏、感觉正常。算快速转运吗？

opts.en: Only if he is in a lot of pain
No, not for the hip alone

quiz.whyEn: An isolated hip fracture is Rapid Transport only with nerve or blood-supply impairment.
quiz.whyZh: 单纯髋部骨折，有神经或血运受损才算快速转运。

quiz.qEn: On the way, the dislocated hip slips back into place. What do you do?
quiz.qZh: 路上，脱位的髋关节自己滑回去了。你做什么？

opts.en: Slow down: it is no longer urgent
Pull on the leg to keep it in

quiz.whyEn: A spontaneous reduction is reported to the receiving hospital.
quiz.whyZh: 自行复位要告诉接收医院。

traction-splint.lineEn: Pain relief and a pulse check come first. Once the traction is on, it is never released.
traction-splint.lineZh: 先镇痛、先查远端。牵引一旦拉上，绝不放松。

items.en: closed fracture: 10% of body weight, at most 15 lbs (7 kg)
items.zh: 闭合骨折：体重的 10%，最多 15 lbs（7 kg）

items.en: open fracture: at most 5 lbs

steps.subZh: 循环 · 感觉 · 活动
敷 10 分钟，停 5 分钟

steps.en: Supine, the leg in line with the body
steps.zh: 仰卧，伤腿和身体成一直线

steps.en: Hold it by hand, recheck the distal pulse
steps.zh: 用手扶稳，再查一次远端脉搏

steps.subEn: lay the splint beside the injured leg
pull the traction, then never release
raise the end of the splint so it lines up with the leg
steps.subZh: 垫高夹板末端，让它和腿成一直线

steps.subEn: three elastic straps · blanket between the legs · legs strapped together
steps.subZh: 三条弹力带 · 两腿间放毯子 · 两腿绑在一起

items.en: Release the traction once it is on.
Use it on an unstable patient, or on anything other than a suspected mid-shaft femur fracture.
items.zh: 给不稳定的病人用，或者用在股骨中段以外的骨折上。

items.en: Each time you move the patient or recheck ABCs or vitals: recheck the traction and correct it.
items.zh: 每次搬动病人、复查 ABC 或生命体征时：再查一次牵引，不对就调。

quiz.qEn: A stable 80 kg man has a closed mid-shaft femur fracture. How much traction?
quiz.qZh: 一名情况稳定的 80 公斤男子，股骨中段闭合骨折。牵引拉多大？

opts.en: 8 kg: ten percent of his weight

quiz.whyEn: Ten percent of 80 kg is 8 kg, which is over the limit. Closed fractures stop at 15 lbs (7 kg).
quiz.whyZh: 80 公斤的 10% 是 8 公斤，超过上限。闭合骨折最多 15 lbs（7 公斤）。

quiz.qEn: The same fracture, but the bone has come through the skin. How much traction?
quiz.qZh: 同样的骨折，但骨头穿出了皮肤。牵引拉多大？
quiz.whyEn: Open mid-shaft fractures: at most 5 lbs.
quiz.whyZh: 开放的股骨中段骨折：最多 5 lbs。

quiz.qEn: You have just lifted him into the ambulance. What do you recheck?
quiz.qZh: 你刚把他抬上救护车。要复查什么？

opts.en: Loosen the traction to rest the leg
The traction and the distal pulse

quiz.whyEn: Traction is reassessed with every movement and every recheck, and it is never released.
quiz.whyZh: 每次搬动、每次复查都要再查牵引。牵引不能松。

pelvis-binding.lineEn: A major mechanism plus any one sign: bind before transport, and do not roll the patient to do it.
pelvis-binding.lineZh: 受伤机制大，再加任何一条：转运前绑好，绑的时候不翻动病人。

blocks.titleEn: Major mechanism + any ONE of these
blocks.titleZh: 重大受伤机制 + 下面任意一条

items.en: Heart rate over 100 or systolic pressure under 90 mmHg.
Pelvic pain on exam.
Pelvic instability.
Decreased level of consciousness.
A major injury that distracts from the pelvic exam.
items.zh: 有别的大伤，干扰了骨盆检查。

items.en: Neck-of-femur ("hip") fracture.
A fall from standing height, or another simple fall.
A commercial pelvic binder, or three overlapping broad triangular bandages.
items.zh: 商用骨盆带，或三条宽三角巾叠着用。

items.en: The centre of the belt over the greater trochanter.
Tight enough to support the pelvis, not tight enough to hurt.
items.zh: 紧到能托住骨盆，不到弄痛病人。

items.en: On before transport.
Use zap straps.
Roll the patient to put the binder on.
items.zh: 为了绑带子而翻动病人。

items.en: The pelvis gets smaller inside, which presses on the bleeding (tamponade).
items.zh: 骨盆内的空间变小，压住出血（tamponade 填塞效应）。

items.en: The broken pieces stop moving, so they bleed less.
items.zh: 骨折块不再乱动，出血减少。

items.en: The patient is more comfortable.

quiz.qEn: A pedestrian was hit by a car. Heart rate 118, blood pressure 104/70, no pelvic pain, pelvis stable, alert, no other big injury. Bind the pelvis?
quiz.qZh: 行人被车撞。心率 118，血压 104/70，骨盆不痛、稳定，清醒，没有别的大伤。绑骨盆吗？

opts.en: No: the pelvis does not hurt

quiz.whyEn: A major mechanism and a heart rate over 100. One sign is enough.
quiz.whyZh: 受伤机制大，加上心率超过 100。有一条就够。

quiz.qEn: Where does the centre of the binder go?
quiz.qZh: 绑带的中心放在哪里？
quiz.whyEn: The greater trochanter, not the iliac crests.
quiz.whyZh: 对准大转子，不是髂嵴。

quiz.qEn: An 82-year-old woman tripped on a rug at home. Her hip hurts and you suspect a neck-of-femur fracture. Bind?
quiz.qZh: 82 岁的老太太在家被地毯绊倒。髋部痛，你怀疑股骨颈骨折。绑吗？
quiz.whyEn: Two reasons not to: a simple fall from standing height, and a neck-of-femur fracture.
quiz.whyZh: 两个不绑的理由都占了：站着摔倒的简单跌倒，加上股骨颈骨折。

spinal-management.lineEn: Restrict spinal motion when the patient meets the NEXUS Criteria or the Canadian C-Spine indications.
spinal-management.lineZh: 病人符合 NEXUS 标准或 Canadian C-Spine（加拿大颈椎）指征时，才做脊柱固定。

steps.en: Hold the head and neck by hand
Secure the body to the device, if appropriate
steps.zh: 需要的话，把身体固定在装置上

items.en: Tape the head.

quiz.qEn: She meets the indications. What goes on first?
quiz.qZh: 她符合指征。第一步做什么？

opts.en: Your hands, on her head and neck
opts.zh: 你的手，稳住她的头和颈

quiz.whyEn: Manual stabilization comes before the collar, the device and the blocks.
quiz.whyZh: 先手动稳住，然后才是颈托、固定装置、头部固定块。

quiz.qEn: The blocks are in place. How do you finish securing him?
quiz.qZh: 头部固定块放好了。最后怎么固定？

opts.en: Strap the body to the device, no tape on the head
opts.zh: 把身体绑在装置上，头上不贴胶带

opts.en: Tape the forehead to the board
opts.zh: 用胶带把额头粘在板上

opts.en: Tape the forehead and the chin
opts.zh: 额头和下巴都用胶带粘住

quiz.whyEn: The body is secured if appropriate. The head is not taped.
quiz.whyZh: 需要的话固定身体。头不贴胶带。

quiz.qEn: What decides whether you restrict spinal motion?
quiz.qZh: 要不要做脊柱固定，根据什么决定？

opts.en: The NEXUS Criteria and the Canadian C-Spine indications
opts.zh: NEXUS 标准和 Canadian C-Spine 指征

quiz.whyEn: You confirm a clinical indication first, using NEXUS or the Canadian C-Spine Guidelines.
quiz.whyZh: 先用 NEXUS 或 Canadian C-Spine 确认有临床指征。

traumatic-brain-injuries.headZh: 头部外伤|+ 意识改变|= 怀疑脑外伤
traumatic-brain-injuries.lineEn: Keep the oxygen up, raise the head 30 degrees and loosen the hard collar.
traumatic-brain-injuries.lineZh: 保住氧合，床头抬高 30 度，松开硬颈托。

items.en: mild
moderate
severe
Oxygenation: SpO₂ 94% or more.
Struggling to breathe: assist ventilations, still keeping SpO₂ at 94% or more.
items.zh: 呼吸撑不住：辅助通气，SpO₂ 仍保持 ≥ 94%。

items.en: Head of the bed up 30 degrees.
Loosen the hard collar.
blood sugar, mmol/L
systolic pressure, mmHg
TKVO, if systolic is over 120
TXA (tranexamic acid) for an isolated TBI. It is contraindicated.
items.zh: 单纯脑外伤用 TXA 氨甲环酸（tranexamic acid）。这是禁忌。

quiz.qEn: A man fell from a ladder onto his head. GCS 8. How severe?
quiz.qZh: 一名男子从梯子上摔下，头着地。GCS 8。算多重？
quiz.whyEn: GCS 8 or less is a severe traumatic brain injury. 9 to 12 is moderate, 13 and up is mild.
quiz.whyZh: GCS ≤ 8 是重度脑外伤。9–12 中度，≥ 13 轻度。

quiz.qEn: A cyclist has a head injury and a hard collar on. Which pair does the guideline ask for?
quiz.qZh: 一名骑车人头部受伤，已经上了硬颈托。考纲要求哪两件事？

opts.en: Lie him flat and tighten the collar
Head of the bed up 30 degrees, collar loosened
opts.zh: 床头抬高 30 度，松开颈托

quiz.whyEn: Head up 30 degrees and the collar loosened, not removed.
quiz.whyZh: 床头抬高 30 度；颈托是松开，不是摘掉。

quiz.qEn: Her breathing slows and her SpO₂ falls to 89%. What now?
quiz.qZh: 她呼吸变慢，SpO₂ 掉到 89%。现在怎么办？

opts.en: Watch it for five more minutes
Assist her ventilations and get SpO₂ to 94% or more
opts.zh: 辅助通气，把 SpO₂ 拉回 ≥ 94%

quiz.whyEn: If the patient cannot maintain respirations, assist ventilations and keep SpO₂ at 94% or more.
quiz.whyZh: 病人自己维持不了呼吸，就辅助通气，SpO₂ 保持 ≥ 94%。

quiz.qEn: An isolated head injury, GCS 10. Do you give TXA (tranexamic acid)?
quiz.qZh: 单纯头部外伤，GCS 10。给 TXA 氨甲环酸（tranexamic acid） 吗？

opts.zh: 不给：单纯脑外伤是禁忌

quiz.whyEn: TXA is contraindicated for isolated traumatic brain injuries.
quiz.whyZh: 单纯脑外伤禁用 TXA。

burn-management.lineEn: Cool running water, not cold. The time a bystander already spent cooling counts.
burn-management.lineZh: 用凉的流动水，不是冰水。旁人已经冲过的时间算在里面。

steps.subEn: if you suspect an inhalation injury, or short of breath
steps.subZh: 怀疑吸入性损伤，或者气短

steps.subEn: BSA, by the Rule of Nines

items.en: Cool, not cold, and running water wherever you can.
items.zh: 凉水，不是冰水，能用流动水就用流动水。

items.en: No immediate threat to life: staying on scene more than 20 minutes to cool is acceptable.
items.zh: 没有马上危及生命的伤：为了冲水在现场停留超过 20 分钟是可以的。

items.en: Has to go now: cool saline may be enough.
items.zh: 必须马上走：用凉的生理盐水可能就够。

items.en: Cooling is pain relief too.

rows.en: When the cooling is finished: sterile, nonstick, dry gauze.
rows.zh: 冷却结束后：盖无菌、不粘、干的纱布。

items.en: Use cold or iced water.
Dress it wet. After the cooling the gauze is dry.
items.zh: 盖湿敷料。冷却之后用的是干纱布。

items.en: if indicated
fluid if hypotensive, at most 2 litres
items.zh: 低血压时补液，最多 2 升

quiz.qEn: A neighbour held the man's scalded arm under the tap for 10 minutes before you arrived. How much more cooling?
quiz.qZh: 你到之前，邻居已经把他烫伤的手臂放在水龙头下冲了 10 分钟。还要冲多久？

opts.en: None: go straight to the dressing

quiz.whyEn: The 15 to 20 minutes include the time bystanders spent cooling effectively.
quiz.whyZh: 15–20 分钟包含了旁人已经有效冲水的时间。

quiz.qEn: The cooling is finished. What goes on the burn?
quiz.qZh: 冷却结束了。烧伤处盖什么？
quiz.whyEn: Once cooling has finished the wound is dressed with sterile, nonstick, dry gauze.
quiz.whyZh: 冷却结束后，用无菌、不粘、干的纱布覆盖。

quiz.qEn: A woman pulled from a house fire is short of breath. What do you add in the primary?
quiz.qZh: 一名女子从着火的房子里被救出来，气短。Primary 里要加什么？

opts.en: A cold wet towel on her face

quiz.whyEn: High-flow oxygen for a suspected inhalation injury or shortness of breath.
quiz.whyZh: 怀疑吸入性损伤或气短，给高流量氧。

abdominal-injuries.headZh: 肠子露出来，|绝不塞回去。
abdominal-injuries.lineEn: A moist sterile dressing first, an occlusive layer on top. Keep the patient still and warm.
abdominal-injuries.lineZh: 先盖湿的无菌敷料，上面再盖一层密封层。让病人少动、保暖。

steps.subEn: so the clots are not disturbed
moist sterile dressing, then an occlusive layer
steps.subZh: 湿的无菌敷料，再加一层密封层

items.en: Put the contents back into the abdomen.
Vascular access, and correct hypoperfusion.
items.zh: 建立静脉通路，纠正低灌注。

items.en: TXA (tranexamic acid), if indicated.
items.zh: 有指征就给 TXA 氨甲环酸（tranexamic acid）。

quiz.qEn: A man has been stabbed in the belly. A loop of bowel is showing. What do you put on it?
quiz.qZh: 一名男子腹部被刺，露出一段肠子。上面盖什么？

opts.en: Nothing: push it back in and bandage
opts.zh: 什么都不盖：塞回去再包扎

opts.en: A moist sterile dressing, then an occlusive layer
opts.zh: 湿的无菌敷料，再加一层密封层

quiz.whyEn: Moist and sterile first, occlusive on top, and the contents are never put back.
quiz.whyZh: 先湿的无菌敷料，再盖密封层。内脏绝不塞回去。

quiz.qEn: Why do you keep him as still as you can?
quiz.qZh: 为什么要让他尽量不动？

opts.en: Movement can break up the clots
opts.zh: 一动可能把血凝块弄散

quiz.whyEn: Movement is limited to reduce clot disruption.
quiz.whyZh: 少动是为了不破坏已经形成的血凝块。

quiz.qEn: The wound is covered. Which two things come before you leave?
quiz.qZh: 伤口盖好了。出发前还有哪两件事？

opts.en: Sit him upright and give him water
Keep him warm, in a position of comfort
opts.zh: 给他保暖，摆一个舒服的体位

opts.en: Have him walk to the stretcher

quiz.whyEn: Protect against heat loss and use a position of comfort.
quiz.whyZh: 防止失温，摆舒服的体位。

quiz.qEn: When do the IV and TXA (tranexamic acid) happen?
quiz.qZh: 静脉通路和 TXA 氨甲环酸（tranexamic acid） 什么时候做？

opts.en: On scene, before he is moved

quiz.whyEn: The PCP interventions for abdominal injuries are done en route.
quiz.whyZh: 腹部损伤的 PCP 处置都在路上做。

chest-trauma.lineEn: Then watch for a tension pneumothorax. A flail chest is held still by hand.
chest-trauma.lineZh: 封好后盯着有没有张力性气胸（tension pneumothorax）。连枷胸（flail chest）用手稳住。

items.en: Control any bleeding with gauze.
Assist oxygenation and ventilation if necessary.
items.zh: 需要的话辅助给氧和通气。

items.en: Seal an open chest wound: a three-sided occlusive dressing, or a commercial chest seal.
items.zh: 封住开放性胸部伤口：三边密封敷料，或商用胸部封贴（chest seal）。

items.en: Flail chest: stabilize it manually.
Position the patient as soon as possible.

blocks.actZh: 紧盯有没有张力性气胸

items.en: Vascular access if required.
items.zh: 需要的话建立静脉通路。

items.en: TXA (tranexamic acid), if indicated.
items.zh: 有指征就给 TXA 氨甲环酸（tranexamic acid）。

quiz.qEn: A man has an open wound in his chest wall and air is moving through it. What do you put on it?
quiz.qZh: 一名男子胸壁有开放伤口，有气体进出。上面盖什么？

opts.en: A three-sided occlusive dressing or a chest seal
opts.zh: 三边密封敷料，或胸部封贴

opts.en: A dressing taped down tightly on all four sides

quiz.whyEn: Open chest wounds are sealed with a three-sided occlusive dressing or a commercial chest seal. Chest wounds are never packed.
quiz.whyZh: 开放性胸部伤口用三边密封敷料或商用胸部封贴。胸部伤口不填塞。

quiz.qEn: Five minutes after the seal goes on, he shows signs of a tension pneumothorax. What do you do?
quiz.qZh: 封好五分钟后，他出现张力性气胸的表现。你怎么办？

opts.en: Add a second seal on top

quiz.whyEn: After sealing you monitor closely for a tension pneumothorax and relieve it if it develops.
quiz.whyZh: 封好之后紧盯张力性气胸，出现了就减压。

quiz.qEn: A section of her chest wall moves the wrong way when she breathes. How do you stabilize it?
quiz.qZh: 她呼吸时有一块胸壁反着动。怎么稳住？

opts.en: With tape wound tightly round the chest

quiz.whyEn: A flail chest is stabilized manually.
quiz.whyZh: 连枷胸用手稳住。

electrical-contact.lineEn: Qualified personnel clear the scene first. Then think spine, think heart, and treat the burn.
electrical-contact.lineZh: 先由专业人员确认现场安全。然后：想到脊柱，想到心脏，再处理烧伤。

items.en: Find out the type of current and how long the contact lasted.
items.zh: 弄清电流类型和接触了多久。

items.en: Estimate the burned area with the Burn Estimation Charts.
items.zh: 用烧伤面积估算图（Burn Estimation Charts）估算面积。

items.en: Go, and consider an intercept with additional resources.
items.zh: 出发，考虑和增援在途中会合。

items.en: A large area was cooled: consider the ambulance heater on the way.
items.zh: 冷却的面积大：路上考虑开救护车暖气。

items.en: No inhalation injury: consider analgesia to effect.
items.zh: 没有吸入性损伤：考虑镇痛，给到起效。

items.en: Go near a power source or a downed line before qualified personnel say it is safe.
items.zh: 专业人员确认安全之前，靠近电源或掉落的电线。

items.en: Cool the burns for more than 15 to 20 minutes. That total includes the decontamination time.
items.zh: 冷却烧伤超过 15–20 分钟。这个时间包括冲洗去污的时间。

items.en: Vascular access.
Hypotensive: consider other causes of shock.
items.zh: 低血压：考虑其他原因造成的休克。

items.en: Fluid bolus 20 ml/kg, at most 2 litres, reassessing every 500 ml.
items.zh: 补液 20 ml/kg，最多 2 升，每 500 ml 复查一次。

quiz.qEn: A man is lying next to a fallen power line and is not moving. What do you do?
quiz.qZh: 一名男子倒在掉落的电线旁，一动不动。你怎么做？

opts.en: Stay back until qualified personnel declare it safe
opts.zh: 退后，等专业人员宣布安全

opts.en: Pull him clear with a dry wooden pole

quiz.whyEn: You do not approach electrical sources or downed lines until qualified personnel have deemed the scene safe.
quiz.whyZh: 专业人员确认现场安全之前，不靠近电源或掉落的电线。

quiz.qEn: The scene is now safe. He has no pulse. What comes first?
quiz.qZh: 现场安全了。他没有脉搏。先做什么？
quiz.whyEn: In cardiac arrest you begin compressions and follow the resuscitation guidelines.
quiz.whyZh: 心脏骤停就开始按压，按复苏流程走。

quiz.qEn: You have flushed a woman's electrical burns for 10 minutes. How much more cooling is allowed?
quiz.qZh: 你已经给一名女子的电烧伤冲洗了 10 分钟。最多还能再冷却多久？
quiz.whyEn: Cooling stops at 15 to 20 minutes in total, and the decontamination time is part of it.
quiz.whyZh: 冷却总共不超过 15–20 分钟，冲洗去污的时间也算在内。

quiz.qEn: After an electrical contact his blood pressure is low. Besides the fluid bolus, what must you think of?
quiz.qZh: 触电后他血压低。除了补液，还必须想到什么？

opts.en: Nothing else: it is the burn
opts.zh: 不用多想，就是烧伤引起的

quiz.whyEn: Hypotensive after electrical contact: consider other causes of shock. Bolus 20 ml/kg to at most 2 litres, reassessing every 500 ml.
quiz.whyZh: 触电后低血压：考虑其他原因的休克。补液 20 ml/kg，最多 2 升，每 500 ml 复查一次。
